descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-07 ER 3; TFA-92585 AC 8 · “A task closed by dictation shows as completed, with the visit it was closed on.”.

Bug N41 · S1 · new

Nursing Home: a task closed by dictation shows the previous visit (or no visit for a first-visit resident) unless today's pre-round was saved first

Tickets: TFA-92585 AC 8 · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local (8b4be94a)

Note: Local + dev (TC-07/S08, TC-22/S03). Hospital shows 'Done Oct 20' correctly.

Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S08 A task closed by dictation (Save & Extract) shows as completed, with the visit it was closed on

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 A task closed by dictation shows as completed, with the visit it was closed on (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given A seeded Hospital patient and a seeded Nursing Home resident on Today's Visits with one earlier visit (so today is visit 2), each with two open tasks

When Type an encounter text that answers one task into the encounter notes box, tap Save & Extract, then open Task Export; after the run the harness reads the stored tasks and diagnostics:list

Then The answered task is in the completed part at the bottom, with the visit it was closed on (Nursing Home: visit 2, in that task's row); the other task stays pending above it with no visit label; same in Hospital, where the label is recorded until Q3

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U5 + U2: the open task above and the closed task below the completed heading (anchor pairs, oracleRules 8). Nursing Home: 'Visit 2' in the 'Recheck INR' row (attributedTo) and no visit label in the 'Order TSH' row (notAttributedTo) — known until PR #106 (doneVisit). Hospital: the label in the 'Repeat BMP in the morning' row is recorded, not judged, until Q3; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent (AGENT (real Save & Extract)); secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-07 Task Export · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-07/S08

A task closed by dictation (Save & Extract) shows as completed, with the visit it was closed on

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for qa)

Detail:

Hospital: 'Repeat BMP in the morning' closed by Save & Extract → under Finished Tasks with its patient, 'Done Oct 20' (server day; Hospital reading of Q3), 'Order PT evaluation' pending above — pass. Nursing Home, one earlier visit, 'Recheck INR' closed by Save & Extract: (a) as the matrix seeds it (snfVisitDates only, no course ledger, no pre-round today) → 'Done Oct 20', no visit at all (stored doneVisit undefined); (b) ledger 'Visit 1 · Oct 13' and no pre-round today → 'Done Oct 20 · Visit 1' (stored doneVisit 1) although today is visit 2; (c) after today's pre-round Save Note (ledger gets 'Visit 2 · Oct 20: Pre-rounded.') → 'Done Oct 20 · Visit 2' — pass. The server stamps the LAST visit on the course ledger (convex/lib/taskStamps.ts + lastVisitNumber), so a dictation closing a task before today's pre-round names the previous visit, and a resident with no ledger line gets none. Same in TC-22/S03 (first visit, typed tasks): 'Done Oct 20' with no visit.

This is the flow WITH today's pre-round; without it…
